latest.title: Full cover for a new shop, and a demand plan after 9 days
latest.summary: A new shop can now run a demand test: the Staffing block offers Full cover 24/7 beside its usual plan, every serving station staffed every hour with the fewest people the game's rules allow, and a step to open every day 0 to 24. Nine days after the shop's first customer the board has the shop's own week and gives it the demand plan, without waiting two weeks. Hours nobody came count as no customers. When the data is in and the shop is still fully staffed, the Staffing block and Today say to switch to the demand plan. Plans now say in one step how many people to add: who to assign from your unassigned staff and how many to hire, and hire counts are the true minimum.
